purpose: Allow a SPIn-NeRF reference_binary_mask to authorize only the native source-raster geometry and immutable source-file identity needed to export the query-free exact compositor matrix W.
claim_boundary: Exporter/header authority only. The reference mask may not be decoded, converted, materialized as an array/tensor, interpreted as foreground/background, passed to an adjoint, or used to construct query evidence or a metric.

legacy_contract.positive_negative_scribbles: The existing _native_prompt_shape branch, source SHA keys, authority construction, compositor execution, and tensor-cache construction remain unchanged.
legacy_contract.artifact_note: The exporter_source SHA naturally changes when the source file changes; this registration makes no claim that whole-file serialized cache hashes remain equal across exporter source revisions. Exact W tensors and legacy control flow remain unchanged.

required_cli_expectations: lowercase SHA-256 of the complete source mask file
allowed_file_access: PIL lazy Image.open context sufficient to inspect format-independent width and height
raw binary streaming of the complete file for SHA-256

required_tests: header-only full-mask access rejects any accidental load, convert, pixel, NumPy, or tensor operation
unsupported or mismatched prompt type fails closed
native height or width mismatch fails closed
complete-file SHA mismatch or malformed expected SHA fails closed
full-mask metadata binds prompt type, reference frame, SHA, H/W, and no-target/no-decode flags
